operations.title: Physical kernel quotients and invariant scalar quotients are distinct constructions
operations.summary: G/K_phys classifies source transformations invisible to a family of linear physical-observable representations. Spec A[V]^G classifies invariant scalar records of a covariant multiplet and can retain nonabelian orbit information. Neither construction generally determines the other.

operations.title: Arithmetic organizes commutative invariant-record algebras rather than group abelianizations
operations.summary: Stable arithmetic structure should be sought in algebras of invariant scalar records produced by typed physical constructors. The underlying Carrier groupoid and covariant multiplets may remain nonabelian.

authority_basis.summary: Continuing the hostile audit and superseding an overbroad abelianization hypothesis with the verified invariant-quotient distinction.
